m: Soften the onion 8 minutes, add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the curry paste for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas. Simmer 15 minutes, crushing some chickpeas to thicken it.
Stir through the spinach until wilted. Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon if you have one.
Serve with rice, yoghurt, naan and coriander.
l: Freezes and reheats well. Great for a meat-free day.
g: GF wraps or extra rice instead of naan, and check the curry paste.
